turn1.evidence: All 12 top examples (8–10) are bird-name tokens, many outside bird contexts: 'Swan Lake', 'lame duck', 'green swan', the surname 'Yvik Swan', 'Robert Falcon Scott', 'The Flamingos', the acronym 'SWAN' and the cmdlet 'Run-Kestrel'. All mid-range examples are instead month abbreviations before a day number, which have no semantic link to birds.
